necessary_conditions.capacity_exposure: sum of outstanding D credit blocks must exceed the physical pool while a useful P GPU or D GPU is idle
necessary_conditions.decode_compute_exposure: Decode arrival work exceeds sustainable batch token service or its queue delays the target event
necessary_conditions.network_exposure: source cut serialization minus profile-backed overlap slack must be positive at P2D-ready

oracle_constraint: Any oracle must preserve four P GPUs, one D GPU, their normal KV pools, the same100-Gb/s cut, workload bytes and causal release times.
